Author:     Daniel Darnell <daniel@thunderbird.net>

Commit:     Daniel Darnell <daniel@thunderbird.net>

    Bug 1893603 - Add beetmover apt pushing for .deb repackage. r=coreycb
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D264112

diff --git a/taskcluster/config.yml b/taskcluster/config.yml
index f9ff3479ad0..70679f987bc 100644
--- a/taskcluster/config.yml
+++ b/taskcluster/config.yml
@@ -35,6 +35,7 @@ treeherder:
         'BMcs': 'Beetmover checksums,'
         'BMcss': 'Beetmover checksums for source'
         'BMR': 'Beetmover repackages'
+        'BM-apt': 'Beetmover APT (.deb) packages'
         'c-Up': 'Balrog submission of complete updates'
         'cs': 'Checksum signing'
         'css': 'Checksum signing for source'
diff --git a/taskcluster/kinds/beetmover-apt/kind.yml b/taskcluster/kinds/beetmover-apt/kind.yml
new file mode 100644
index 00000000000..e804c562eb1
--- /dev/null
+++ b/taskcluster/kinds/beetmover-apt/kind.yml
@@ -0,0 +1,28 @@
+# This Source Code Form is subject to the terms of the Mozilla Public
+# License, v. 2.0. If a copy of the MPL was not distributed with this
+# file, You can obtain one at http://mozilla.org/MPL/2.0/.
+---
+loader: taskgraph.loader.transform:loader
+
+transforms:
+    - taskgraph.transforms.from_deps
+    - gecko_taskgraph.transforms.release:run_on_releases
+    - gecko_taskgraph.transforms.beetmover_apt
+    - gecko_taskgraph.transforms.task
+
+kind-dependencies:
+    - beetmover-repackage
+
+only-for-build-platforms:
+    - linux-shippable/opt
+    - linux64-shippable/opt
+
+tasks:
+    beetmover-apt:
+        from-deps:
+            group-by: single-with-filters
+        run-on-releases:
+            - nightly
+            - beta
+            - release
+            - esr140
